title: Oppenheimer
overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the Manhattan Project, from the race to build the first atomic bomb to the security hearing that later tried to undo him.

title: Barbie
overview: When her perfect days in Barbieland start to go wrong, Barbie travels to the real world with Ken in tow and discovers that being human is messier, and richer, than plastic.

title: Dune: Part Two
overview: Paul Atreides joins the Fremen of Arrakis and wages war on the house that destroyed his family, while trying to avert the terrible future his visions keep showing him.

title: Poor Things
overview: Brought back to life by an eccentric surgeon, Bella Baxter runs off across continents with a rakish lawyer, hungry to learn everything about a world she is seeing for the first time.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
overview: Miles Morales is pulled across the multiverse, where a society of Spider-People is sworn to protect it. When they clash over how to handle a new threat, Miles has to redefine what being a hero means.

title: Killers of the Flower Moon
overview: In 1920s Oklahoma, members of the oil-rich Osage Nation are murdered one after another. A marriage sits at the centre of the conspiracy that the newly formed FBI comes to investigate.

title: The Holdovers
overview: Over the Christmas break of 1970, a curmudgeonly teacher at a New England boarding school is stuck on campus with a troubled student and the school's grieving head cook.

title: Past Lives
overview: Two childhood friends from Seoul are separated when one family emigrates. Decades later they meet again for one week in New York and face the lives they did not live.

title: Godzilla Minus One
overview: Japan is still on its knees after the war when a gigantic creature rises from the sea. A guilt-ridden former pilot and a band of civilians have to find a way to stop it.

title: The Boy and the Heron
overview: Mourning his mother, young Mahito moves to the countryside, where a talking grey heron lures him into a tower that opens onto a world shared by the living and the dead.

title: Anatomy of a Fall
overview: A writer is tried for the death of her husband, found below the window of their chalet in the French Alps. Their visually impaired son is the only witness, and the trial dissects the whole marriage.

title: The Zone of Interest
overview: The commandant of Auschwitz and his wife build an idyllic family life in a house and garden that share a wall with the camp.

title: Civil War
overview: In a near-future United States torn apart by armed conflict, a team of journalists drives to Washington, D.C. hoping to reach the president before the capital falls.

title: Challengers
overview: A former tennis prodigy turned coach enters her struggling champion husband in a low-level tournament, where he must face her ex-boyfriend, who was once his best friend.

title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
overview: Snatched from the Green Place as a child, Furiosa grows up between two warlords fighting over the Wasteland and spends years plotting her way back home.

title: Inside Out 2
overview: Riley turns thirteen and headquarters gets a sudden renovation: Anxiety and other new emotions move in, and Joy's team has to fight for its place in Riley's mind.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
overview: Recruited against his will by the Time Variance Authority, Deadpool drags a reluctant Wolverine from another universe into a mission to save his own timeline.

title: Alien: Romulus
overview: A group of young colonists scavenging a derelict space station in search of a way off their mining world come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

title: The Substance
overview: Dropped by her network at fifty, a fading star tries a black-market drug that creates a younger, flawless version of herself. The two must share one life, on a strict schedule.

title: The Wild Robot
overview: Shipwrecked on an uninhabited island, a service robot learns to survive among the animals and becomes the unlikely parent of an orphaned gosling.

title: Anora
overview: A young dancer from Brooklyn impulsively marries the son of a Russian oligarch. Her fairy tale is threatened as soon as his parents hear the news and send people to have it annulled.

title: Conclave
overview: After the pope dies, Cardinal Lawrence must run the secretive election of his successor, and uncovers ambitions and secrets that could shake the foundations of the Church.

title: Wicked
overview: Long before Dorothy arrives in Oz, misunderstood Elphaba and popular Glinda become unlikely friends at Shiz University, until an encounter with the Wizard sends them down opposite paths.

title: Gladiator II
overview: Years after watching Maximus die, Lucius is captured and forced into the Colosseum, where he fights for the honour of a Rome now ruled by tyrant emperors.

title: The Brutalist
overview: A visionary Hungarian architect who survived the Holocaust emigrates to the United States, where a wealthy industrialist offers him the commission of a lifetime, at a price.

title: Nosferatu
overview: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman in 19th-century Germany and the ancient vampire who is infatuated with her, bringing untold horror in his wake.

title: A Complete Unknown
overview: New York, 1961. A nineteen-year-old from Minnesota named Bob Dylan arrives in Greenwich Village with a guitar, and within four years turns folk music, and then rock, upside down.

title: Mickey 17
overview: Mickey has the worst job on a colony ship: he is an expendable, sent on lethal missions and reprinted after each death. Trouble starts when one of his copies survives.

title: Sinners
overview: Twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown in 1932 to open a juke joint and start over, only to find that something far older and hungrier is waiting for opening night.

title: Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning
overview: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team race against time to find and destroy the Entity, a rogue artificial intelligence that could bring down every system mankind depends on.

title: 28 Years Later
overview: Almost three decades after the rage virus escaped, a boy raised on a quarantined island crosses to the mainland and discovers what has become of the infected, and of the survivors.

title: F1: The Movie
overview: A driver whose Formula One career ended in a crash in the 1990s is talked into returning to the grid to mentor a gifted rookie and save a team at the bottom of the standings.

title: Superman
overview: Superman tries to reconcile his Kryptonian heritage with his upbringing as Clark Kent of Smallville, while Lex Luthor works to turn the world against him.

title: Weapons
overview: At 2:17 one night, every child but one from the same classroom gets out of bed and runs into the dark. A shaken town is left wondering who, or what, is behind it.

title: One Battle After Another
overview: A burnt-out former revolutionary living off the grid has to pull himself together when an old enemy resurfaces after sixteen years and his teenage daughter goes missing.

title: Frankenstein
overview: Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant and arrogant scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ends up destroying both the creator and his creation.
